status.description: The job's status AFTER this slice. `paused` = the daily embed budget was reached; the next scheduled fire resumes it.

embeddedChunks.description: Resume cursor — chunks embedded into the staging namespace so far.

done.description: True once the job reached a TERMINAL status (`done`/`failed`/`cancelled`), which is when the host tears the per-collection workflow + scheduler job down.

error.description: The job's last error/pause reason, when it has one.
